filters.description: The filters to apply to the room info.

items.description:
The fields to include in the response.

id - The file entry ID.
rootFolderId - The root folder ID of the file entry.
canShare - Specifies if the file entry can be shared or not.
security - The actions that can be performed with the file entry.
title - The file entry title.
access - The access rights to the file entry.
shared - Specifies if the file entry is shared or not.
created - The creation date and time of the file entry.
createdBy.id - The user ID.
createdBy.displayName - The user display name.
createdBy.isAnonim - Specifies if the user is anonymous or not.
fileEntryType - The file entry type.
parentId - The parent folder ID of the folder.
filesCount - The number of files that the folder contains.
foldersCount - The number of folders that the folder contains.
isShareable - Specifies if the folder can be shared or not.
isFavorite - Specifies if the folder is favorite or not.
tags - The list of tags of the folder.
roomType - The room type of the folder.
private - Specifies if the folder is private or not.
type - The folder type.
inRoom - Specifies if the folder is placed in the room or not.

roomType.description:
The room type of the folder.

1 - Form Filling Room. Upload PDF forms into the room. Invite members and guests to fill out a PDF form. Review completed forms and analyze data automatically collected in a spreadsheet.
2 - Collaboration room. Collaborate on one or multiple documents with your team.
5 - Custom room. Apply your own settings to use this room for any custom purpose.
6 - Public room. Share documents for viewing, editing, commenting, or reviewing without registration. You can also embed this room into any web interface.
8 - Virtual Data Room. Use VDR for advanced file security and transparency. Set watermarks, automatically index and track all content, restrict downloading and copying.
